newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady on higher turnover.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were steady on the money market Friday morning amid balanced trade, dealers said.
"The morning saw brisker trade with the demand for kuna funds being fully met and one million kuna ($172,000) still left on the surplus side," a dealer told Reuters.
Trade totalled 37.8 million kuna, up a third from Thursday.
Call money accounted for most of the fresh borrowings mostly at 10.5 percent, although one loan was struck at 11 percent.
One smaller short-term loan was granted at 12 percent.
Thursday's overnight trade totalled 45 million kuna as banks made borrowings to maintain mandatory reserves. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 5.810 Croatian Kuna)
